bias.en: Bullish trend · pulling back toward the 10-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 回调至 10 日均线附近

read.en: Palantir fell 3.7% on Oct 14 to $200.97, a second straight decline since the Oct 12 record high of $212.94. It slipped below its 5-day average ($205.3) and is above the 10-day ($198.1), 30-day ($185.3), 100-day ($156.1) and 200-day ($152.5), all rising. MACD is above its signal (since Oct 6) but the histogram is narrowing, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Sep 21 ($196.5), and RSI is 63.
read.zh: Palantir 10月14日下跌 3.7%，收于 $200.97，为 10月12日创下 $212.94 纪录高点后连续第二个下跌日。股价跌破 5 日均线（$205.3），并在均上行的 10 日（$198.1）、30 日（$185.3）、100 日（$156.1）和 200 日均线（$152.5）上方。MACD 位于信号线上方（自 10月6日起），但柱状图收窄，抛物线 SAR 自 9月21日起看多（$196.5），RSI 为 63。

read.en: The $204 support (5-day average, Oct 8 high) broke and turns into resistance, with the $213 record above it. The day's low was $199.74. Support is $196.5–198 (10-day average and SAR), then $193–195 (Sep 24 high) and $185 (30-day average). A close below $196.5 would flip the SAR bearish and open $193; a close above $213 would be a new record.
read.zh: $204 支撑（5 日均线、10月8日高点）失守，转为阻力，其上为 $213 纪录高点。当日低点 $199.74。支撑为 $196.5–198（10 日均线及 SAR），其次 $193–195（9月24日高点）和 $185（30 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $196.5，SAR 将转为看空并打开至 $193 的空间；收盘站上 $213 则创纪录新高。
